Name: Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 BUGFIXES
Author: DutchLudi
Description:
As it says on the tin, this is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6005]Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2[/url] map with some bugfixes:
﻿﻿-Changing in and out of your swimsuit is less of a hassle.
﻿﻿-You can decorate more of the walls and floors
﻿.﻿-The crib won't glitch out if you change the wallpaper.﻿

I tweaked the size of the living room and added an extra large room as well as a fake wall to retrieve out-of-bound items.The fake wall is only at the second upgrade.The large room was made with Free Love's increased max children in mind but should still be useable as a workshop. Interact with the white barn doors in the crib room.The basement entrance was also customized (I only changed the entrance so it's compatible with any basement mod)

 There are two versions;
﻿﻿-Four Crib; adds three extra cribs to the house *
﻿-Vanilla; normal house setup with the large room as an extra.

*Hadn't had the chance to test this with children yet but should(?) work. Though the non-vanilla cribs can't be removed.

I don't intend to make an Android version.

INSTALL:
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]
Extract the zip file in the newly created "...\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder

***IMPORTANT***
If you don't want the rooftop garden make sure, after extracting, to delete the folder called:
"[TMXL] Seasonal Gardern Farmhouse V2".

P.S.
﻿Though not mentioned on the original modpage the toilet is marked as an entrance to the sewers.
